page.overview:
Who is Count Down?

Count Down is a boss who appears in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars. It is a giant clock that is accompanied by two Ding-A-Lings, which are two bells mounted on it. Count Down appears to be controlled by the Ding-A-Lings, and all of them work for Smithy of his gang. Count Down and the Ding-A-Lings are also fought in The Factory.

Count Down is a very unique boss at it uses magical attacks depending on what the time the clock hands land on.

The key to defeating Count Down is to defeat the two Ding-A-Lings on its head so that they will not all attack at once. Count Down is also weak to Jump attacks, thunder attacks, and Snowy so Mario and Mallow are highly recommended for this fight.
